svg.title: Shadewright on Azure: environment layer and cluster layer
svg.desc: Two layers. The environment layer is deployed once and shared by several clusters: a Foundry account with the model deployments, a Key Vault with the GitHub App key, the analysis-record storage account, a Log Analytics workspace for the audit log, and the network access of each service: by default public endpoints restricted to the cluster's subnet or egress IPs with Entra ID only access, on request private endpoints with private DNS. The cluster layer is deployed once per cluster: a managed identity each for the analyzer and the executor, a federated credential for each that trusts the cluster's OIDC issuer and one ServiceAccount, the role assignments on the environment layer's resources, and an output of Helm values. Each cluster layer reads the outputs of the environment layer. The existing AKS cluster and the virtual network are brought by the adopter, never created.
svg.text: ENVIRONMENT LAYER, ONCE, SHARED BY CLUSTERS
Default: public endpoints, Entra ID only, service firewall for the cluster's subnet or egress IPs. On request: private endpoints, DNS module, existing or policy.
Outputs: resource IDs, endpoint names and, in private mode, the zones and records the services expect.
Reads the environment layer's outputs. Trusts the cluster's OIDC issuer, passed in. One identity per component, never one token for both.
Brought by the adopter, never created: the AKS cluster, its VNet and subnets, hubs, firewalls and the private DNS zones of a hub.
